title: Thai Melon Salad
description: A refreshing and light vegan salad perfect for warm days
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced melon and chopped elegant
In a small pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat
Add the chopped roast and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant
Add the cooked roast to the bowl with the melon and elegant
Toss everything together and serve immediately
